dataStatus: Illustrative recipes for the Chapeau portfolio demo. These details have not been verified against a real kitchen or supplier labels.
allergenNotice: Allergen tags describe the demo recipes, not a complete safety assessment. An empty list does not mean allergen-free. Please ask your server about allergies, substitutions and cross-contact before ordering.

items.name: Bruschetta
items.description: Tomato, basil and garlic on crisp sourdough.
items.ingredients: Toasted sourdough topped with ripe tomatoes, fresh basil, garlic and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Cos lettuce, Parmesan and croutons with creamy Caesar dressing.
items.ingredients: Crisp cos lettuce, shaved Parmesan and sourdough croutons with a creamy dressing made with egg, anchovies, Dijon mustard and lemon.

items.name: Soup of the Day
items.description: A comforting potato and leek soup with cream and chives.
items.ingredients: Our demo soup is a velvety potato and leek soup, finished with cream, butter and chives, using vegetable stock made with celery.
items.allergenNotes: The soup recipe can change. Ask your server to confirm today's ingredients and allergens.

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.description: Lemon and rosemary chicken with roast potatoes and salad.
items.ingredients: Lemon and rosemary grilled chicken breast with olive-oil roasted potatoes and a dressed mixed-leaf salad.
items.allergenNotes: No listed allergens in the illustrative recipe. This is not an allergen-free claim.

items.name: Beef Burger
items.description: Beef patty, cheddar and salad in a sesame brioche bun.
items.ingredients: Grilled beef patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato and pickles in a sesame brioche bun, with house mayonnaise and mustard sauce.

items.name: Fish & Chips
items.description: Crisp beer-battered fish, golden chips and tartare sauce.
items.ingredients: White fish in a crisp wheat-flour and barley-beer batter, served with golden chips, lemon and egg-based tartare sauce with mustard and capers.
items.allergenNotes: Ask staff about shared fryers and the fish species used.

items.name: Vegetarian Pasta
items.description: Penne with roasted vegetables, tomato, basil and vegetarian cheese.
items.ingredients: Durum-wheat penne with roasted courgette, capsicum, cherry tomatoes, garlic and basil in a tomato sauce, finished with vegetarian hard cheese made from milk.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Espresso-soaked sponge with mascarpone and cocoa.
items.ingredients: Espresso-soaked wheat sponge fingers layered with mascarpone, whipped egg and cocoa.

items.name: Ice Cream
items.description: Two scoops of classic vanilla ice cream.
items.ingredients: Two scoops of vanilla ice cream made with cream, milk, egg yolk and vanilla, served in a bowl.
items.allergenNotes: Other flavours, toppings and cones can introduce additional allergens; confirm any changes with staff.

items.name: Garlic Bread
items.description: Toasted baguette with garlic butter and parsley.
items.ingredients: Warm wheat baguette spread with garlic butter and parsley, toasted until golden.

items.name: Fries
items.description: Golden potato fries finished with sea salt.
items.ingredients: Crisp potato fries cooked in sunflower oil and finished with sea salt.
items.allergenNotes: Coatings, seasoning and shared frying oil must be checked with the kitchen; do not assume the fries are gluten-free.

items.name: Coffee
items.description: Freshly brewed black coffee, with optional milk.
items.ingredients: Freshly brewed black coffee made with roasted coffee beans and water; milk is optional.
items.allergenNotes: Adding dairy milk introduces milk. Plant-based milks may contain soy, oats, gluten or specific tree nuts depending on the product. Confirm the selected milk and shared steam-wand handling with staff.

items.name: Oysters Kilpatrick
items.description: Grilled oysters with smoky bacon and a tangy savoury sauce.
items.ingredients: Oysters grilled in their shells with smoky bacon and a house Worcestershire-style sauce made with anchovies, tamarind, vinegar and spices.
items.allergenNotes: The sauce formulation and bacon supplier can introduce additional allergens; confirm the products used with staff.

items.name: Calamari
items.description: Crisp calamari with lemon and garlic aioli.
items.ingredients: Tender squid dusted in seasoned wheat flour and fried until crisp, served with lemon and garlic aioli made with egg and mustard.
items.allergenNotes: Ask staff about shared frying oil.

items.name: Pâté
items.description: Smooth chicken-liver pate with toasted sourdough.
items.ingredients: Smooth chicken-liver pâté blended with butter, cream, shallots and thyme, served with toasted wheat sourdough.

items.name: Ribeye Steak
items.description: Grilled ribeye with herb butter, roast potatoes and vegetables.
items.ingredients: Grilled ribeye steak finished with garlic and parsley butter, served with roasted potatoes and seasonal vegetables.

items.name: Lamb Rack
items.description: Herb-crusted lamb rack with buttery mash and green beans.
items.ingredients: Roasted lamb rack with a Dijon mustard, wheat-breadcrumb and rosemary crust, served with buttery potato mash and green beans.

items.name: Salmon Fillet
items.description: Pan-seared salmon with lemon-caper butter and seasonal greens.
items.ingredients: Pan-seared salmon with lemon and caper butter, crushed potatoes and seasonal greens.

items.name: Duck Confit
items.description: Crisp duck leg with roast potatoes, red cabbage and orange sauce.
items.ingredients: Slow-cooked duck leg with crisp skin, duck-fat roasted potatoes, braised red cabbage and a fresh orange sauce.
items.allergenNotes: The illustrative sauce uses fresh orange juice and duck cooking juices. Confirm any stock, glaze or sauce substitutions with staff.

items.name: Vegetable Risotto
items.description: Creamy mushroom, pea and asparagus risotto with vegetarian cheese.
items.ingredients: Arborio rice with mushrooms, peas and asparagus, cooked in celery-based vegetable stock and finished with butter and vegetarian hard cheese made from milk.

items.name: Crème Brûlée
items.description: Vanilla custard beneath a delicate caramelised sugar crust.
items.ingredients: Baked vanilla custard made with cream and egg yolks, topped with a thin caramelised sugar crust.

items.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
items.description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten centre and vanilla ice cream.
items.ingredients: Warm dark-chocolate cake with a soft centre, made with butter, egg and wheat flour, served with vanilla ice cream. The demo chocolate contains soy lecithin.

items.name: Cheesecake
items.description: Baked vanilla cheesecake with a biscuit base and berry compote.
items.ingredients: Baked cream-cheese and vanilla cheesecake on a buttery wheat-biscuit base, finished with a berry compote.

items.name: Truffle Fries
items.description: Golden fries with truffle-flavoured oil, Parmesan and parsley.
items.ingredients: Golden potato fries tossed with truffle-flavoured olive oil, grated Parmesan and chopped parsley.
items.allergenNotes: Ask staff about fry coatings, truffle-oil ingredients and shared frying oil.

items.name: Espresso Martini
items.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso, shaken over ice.
items.ingredients: Vodka, coffee liqueur, fresh espresso and sugar syrup, shaken over ice and finished with coffee beans; no cream or egg white in the demo recipe.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Coffee liqueur ingredients and supplier allergen information must be checked; the empty list is not an allergen-free claim.

items.name: House Beer
items.description: A crisp, refreshing lager with a clean malt finish.
items.ingredients: A crisp house lager brewed with water, malted barley, hops and yeast.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the brand and supplier information with staff.

items.name: Craft Pale Ale
items.description: A hop-forward pale ale with citrus and floral notes.
items.ingredients: A hop-forward pale ale brewed with water, barley malt, wheat malt, hops and yeast, with citrus and floral notes.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Brewery recipes vary; confirm the current beer with staff.

items.name: Stout
items.description: Dark roasted malt with coffee and cocoa notes.
items.ingredients: A dark stout brewed with roasted barley, barley malt, water, hops and yeast, with coffee and cocoa notes.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Milk stouts can contain lactose from milk; confirm the actual stout with staff.

items.name: Shiraz
items.description: A red wine with dark-berry fruit and pepper notes.
items.ingredients: Red wine made from Shiraz grapes, with dark-berry and pepper notes. The illustrative wine uses sulphite preservatives.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the bottle's sulphite declaration and any milk- or egg-based fining-agent declarations with staff.

items.name: Chardonnay
items.description: A white wine with stone-fruit and citrus notes.
items.ingredients: White wine made from Chardonnay grapes, with stone-fruit and citrus notes. The illustrative wine uses sulphite preservatives.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the bottle's sulphite declaration and any milk- or egg-based fining-agent declarations with staff.

items.name: Sauvignon Blanc
items.description: A fresh white wine with citrus and herbaceous notes.
items.ingredients: White wine made from Sauvignon Blanc grapes, with fresh citrus and herbaceous notes. The illustrative wine uses sulphite preservatives.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the bottle's sulphite declaration and any milk- or egg-based fining-agent declarations with staff.

items.name: Whiskey
items.description: Oak-aged whiskey, served neat or over ice.
items.ingredients: A measure of oak-aged distilled whiskey, served neat or over ice.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Check the selected brand and any flavourings or mixers with staff; grain origin alone is not a verified allergen declaration for a distilled spirit.

items.name: Vodka
items.description: Unflavoured vodka, served neat or over ice.
items.ingredients: A measure of unflavoured distilled vodka, served neat or over ice.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Brand, flavourings and any added mixers require supplier checks.

items.name: Gin
items.description: Juniper-led gin, served neat or over ice.
items.ingredients: A measure of juniper-led distilled gin, served neat or over ice.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Botanicals vary by brand and can include specific nuts; confirm the gin and any mixer with staff.

items.name: Rum
items.description: Sugar-cane or molasses-based rum, served neat or over ice.
items.ingredients: A measure of sugar-cane or molasses-based distilled rum, served neat or over ice.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Spiced or flavoured rum and any added mixers require supplier checks.

items.name: Cocktail - Mojito
items.description: White rum, fresh lime and mint, topped with soda.
items.ingredients: White rum, fresh lime, mint and sugar, topped with soda water and served over ice.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the rum, any prepared syrups and substitutions with staff.

items.name: Cocktail - Margarita
items.description: Tequila, orange liqueur and lime with a salt rim.
items.ingredients: Tequila, orange liqueur and freshly squeezed lime juice, shaken over ice and served with a salt rim.
items.allergenNotes: Contains alcohol. Confirm the liqueur and any prepared cocktail mix with staff.

items.name: Nuts Mix
items.description: Roasted peanuts, almonds, cashews and walnuts with rosemary.
items.ingredients: Roasted peanuts, almonds, cashews and walnuts tossed with olive oil, rosemary and sea salt.
items.allergenNotes: Nut varieties and seasoning can change; confirm the current mix with staff.

items.name: Olives
items.description: Green and black olives with lemon, garlic and oregano.
items.ingredients: Green and black olives marinated with olive oil, lemon zest, garlic and oregano.
items.allergenNotes: Check the supplier's brine and preservative information, including sulphites where applicable.
